What is a terrarium?

A terrarium is a miniature ecosystem built inside a transparent container using plants, soil, moss, stones and natural decorative elements — a living piece of nature you can keep on a shelf.

🌿 Miniature EcosystemA whole landscape, scaled down.
💧 Self-SustainingLow maintenance, thriving on its own.
🏡 Indoor DécorA quiet, natural centerpiece.
🌱 Living NatureGrows and changes with time.

Basic terrarium care guide

A few simple habits keep your terrarium thriving for years.

☀️

Light

Place your terrarium in bright, indirect light. Avoid harsh direct sun — the enclosed environment can overheat.

💧

Water

Terrariums need very little water. Check the moisture level before adding more.

🌡️

Temperature

Keep it in a stable room temperature, away from vents, radiators and cold windowsills.

🌿

Plant Care

Trim any yellowing leaves and rotate the container occasionally for even growth.

🧹

Cleaning

Wipe the glass gently with a soft cloth to keep the miniature world clear and visible.

🍃

Ventilation

Open lidded terrariums briefly now and then to prevent excess condensation.
